enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running on low through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull sheet over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull sheet. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Breathe. Extend arm. Pull sheet. Turn on back. Breathe. Remain still. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a quick cool shower before the heat builds
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Splash water on face. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and drinking a glass of cold water while checking the heatwave warning on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Pour water into glass. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put down glass. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open weather app. Read warning. Put down phone. Pick up spoon. Scoop cereal. Lift spoon to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Finish breakfast. Put bowl in sink. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work clothes, packing a water bottle and lunch, and reviewing the day's patient schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Take water bottle from nightstand. Put water bottle in backpack. Take lunch box from desk. Put lunch box in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up phone. Open schedule app. Scroll through schedule. Put down phone. Pick up backpack. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Step off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: morning rounds, patient assessments and clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room 1. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vitals. Ask questions. Take notes. Walk to patient room 2. Repeat. Walk to patient room 3. Administer medication. Record. Walk to nurse station. Sit at computer. Type notes. Print documents. Walk to patient room 4. Assess patient. Take notes. Walk to break room. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break, eating and rehydrating in the staff area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open locker. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Open water bottle. Drink water. Eat sandwich. Chew. Swallow. Eat apple. Drink water. Close lunch bag. Put lunch bag in locker. Close locker. Walk out of staff room. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties: afternoon patient care, medication checks and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Return to ward. Check medication cart. Verify patient IDs. Administer medications. Record. Walk to patient room 5. Check IV. Adjust drip. Take notes. Walk to patient room 6. Change dressing. Dispose waste. Wash hands. Walk to nurse station. Update charts. Prepare handover notes. Print handover. Walk to meeting room. Give handover. Walk back to ward.

Walk to bus stop. Wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Walk to bedroom. Change out of scrubs. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a light dinner while the kitchen range hood keeps the room cool
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on range hood. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Place on cutting board. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add chicken. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes. Turn off range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light home clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out t-shirt. Take out shorts. Put on t-shirt. Put on shorts. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the TV and computer, using cold drinks and a fan instead of the air conditioner during the taxed evening peak
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on fan. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Browse internet. Pick up glass. Drink cold water. Put down glass. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Turn off TV. Turn off fan. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down for bed and switching on the air conditioner now that the peak tax period is over
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Turn off fan. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Open wardrobe. Take out pajamas. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull sheet over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull sheet. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Breathe. Extend arm. Pull sheet. Turn on back. Breathe. Remain still. Sleep.
